title: Graham Staines murder: Supreme Court asks State to decide convict Dara Singh's remission plea by August 19
description: The Supreme Court on July 14 granted the Odisha government time till August 19 to decide the remission plea of Dara Singh, a Bajrang Dal member serving a life sentence for the 1999 murder of Australian missionary Graham Staines and his two minor sons [Rabindra Kumar Pal @ Dara Singh v. State of Odisha]A Bench of Justices Manoj Misra and Vijay Bishnoi was informed that the State’s Sentence Review Board had sought the relevant records but was yet to receive them, preventing it from considering Sin
